Add new groups to a scalar multigroup model

add_groups_multigroup.Rd

Estimates the latent mean and variance of each new group in task_data with every item parameter and every existing group's mean and variance held fixed at their values in mod_rec (fixed item parameter calibration), and returns a ModelRecord of the model with the new groups added. Nothing is written to disk.

Usage

add_groups_multigroup(mod_rec, task_data, task, group, min_runs = 100)

Arguments

mod_rec

ModelRecord object for a scalar multigroup model

task_data

data frame nested by task and grouping variables, with columns item_task, the grouping variable(s) (e.g. language, dataset), and data, a list-column of trial-level data frames with (at least) columns run_id, item_uid, correct (logical or 0/1), and chance (chance level of the item)

task

one value in item_task

group

variable whose values are the new groups (string or bare variable); can be a column of either task_data or the nested data. None of its values can already be groups in mod_rec.

min_runs

minimum number of runs for a new group

Value

ModelRecord object

Details

The model is fit to the record's calibration data together with the new groups' data, so that every item has the response categories it was calibrated with. Since everything else is fixed, each new group's estimates depend only on its own data, and are the same whether groups are added together or one at a time. The existing groups' parameters are unchanged, so their scores are too.

Trials are prepared as for scoring: NA correct is dropped and repeated presentations are numbered by dedupe_items(). Items not in the model are dropped (items with no variance are kept, since their parameters are fixed), as are runs with no responses to the model's items. This assumes scalar invariance holds for the new groups and does not test it.

In the returned record, each new group's parameter values are those of the model's second group with its own mean and variance, and the fit statistics and convergence are those of the estimation of the new groups' means and variances. mod_rec@fit$added_groups accumulates, over successive additions, a tibble with each added group's number of runs, number of the model's items with responses, and estimated mean and variance with their standard errors.
